statistics.title: Statistics & Validation
stats.subtitle: Detailed analysis of model performance and statistical validation
stats.compInterpretation: This table compares the main metrics of all models. MCC is the most important metric — a value close to 1 indicates perfect prediction. F1-macro balances precision and recall per class.
stats.balancedAccInterpretation: measures the average recall across classes and gives equal weight to each one, so it is useful when data is imbalanced. In this multiclass analysis, Balanced Accuracy matches macro Recall because both represent the average recall of the classes.
stats.effectSizeInterpretation: Positive differences favor Model 1. The odds ratio indicates how much more frequently a model succeeds when the other fails. Values > 1 favor the first model.
stats.cvNote: Cross validation was performed on TRAIN. It does not correspond to the final evaluation on TEST. TEST metrics can be found in the Comparison tab.
stats.cvInterpretation: Cross validation splits the data into {folds} partitions and evaluates each model on each partition. The mean and standard deviation summarize its stability: low deviation indicates consistent performance across folds.
stats.noCv: No cross validation data available. Run
stats.bootstrapInterpretation: The 95% bootstrap intervals indicate the range where the true metric lies with 95% confidence. Intervals with little overlap may suggest differences, but formal significance must be checked in Cochran Q and McNemar + Holm.
stats.noCochran: No Cochran Q results available. Run
stats.cochranInterpretation: The Cochran Q test evaluates whether all models perform equally at the same time. If the p-value is < 0.05, the null hypothesis is rejected. In that case, the McNemar post-hoc with Holm correction identifies which pairs differ.
stats.mcnemarConclusion: The conclusion is based on the Holm-adjusted p-value (p_holm), not the original p-value. "Favored" is determined by the b vs c discordance in the McNemar table.
stats.effectSizeInterpretation2: Effect size complements hypothesis tests. A large difference in MCC suggests a practically relevant improvement, even if statistical significance is marginal.

disease.healthy.desc: A healthy grapevine leaf shows a uniform green color, firm texture, and no spots or deformations. Healthy leaves are essential for efficient photosynthesis and good grape production.
disease.healthy.symptom1: Uniform green color across the whole surface
disease.healthy.symptom5: Visible veins that are not protruding
disease.black_rot.desc: A fungal disease affecting leaves, shoots, and fruit. It is characterized by circular brown spots with dark margins that can merge and cause premature leaf drop.
disease.black_rot.symptom1: Circular spots ranging from light to dark brown
disease.black_rot.symptom2: Well-defined dark margins around the lesions
disease.black_rot.symptom3: Black dots (pycnidia) visible in the center
disease.black_rot.symptom5: Premature leaf drop in severe cases
disease.black_rot.rec4: Avoid overhead irrigation on the foliage
disease.black_rot.rec5: Monitor frequently during the rainy season
disease.esca.desc: A grapevine wood disease that causes progressive decline. On leaves it appears as an interveinal chlorosis pattern with necrotic spots, known as 'tiger striping'.
disease.esca.symptom3: Characteristic 'tiger striping' pattern on the leaf
disease.esca.symptom5: General decline and dieback of arms
disease.esca.rec1: There is no cure; focus on prevention
disease.esca.rec3: Disinfect pruning tools between each cut
disease.esca.rec4: Avoid unnecessary wounds on the plant
disease.esca.rec6: Apply protective fungicides to pruning wounds
disease.leaf_blight.desc: A foliar disease caused by a fungus that produces dark brown to black angular spots, usually limited by the leaf veins.
disease.leaf_blight.symptom2: Lesions delimited by the leaf veins
disease.leaf_blight.symptom4: Premature leaf drop in severe infections
disease.leaf_blight.symptom5: Loss of vigor and reduced photosynthesis
disease.leaf_blight.rec1: Apply protective fungicides at the first symptoms
disease.leaf_blight.rec4: Remove infected leaves from the ground
